system.description: Known as the Black Hills Havens, it is a collection of various small pre war towns that are largely undisturbed by GENESIS and its control. This is primarily thanks to some policies created by those in charge in Neo-Seattle, though the reason behind it is nefarious. Every once in a while GENESIS will come by to offer genetic treatments to those inhabiting this region as it is the most exposed to paraphysical radiation from the Glasslands. Of course those deemed "too sick" are whisked away for the health of the others.

The Blackrock Desert is oddly a location that hasn't changed all that much from how it was before the war. Primarily a vast region of largely unlivable arid desert this rocky terrain doesn't provide too much for those in it at first glance. In truth though this area is still a viable strategic location with its central location and rocky outcroppings could prove rich in resources and defensive posture.

Hidden away in the rugged and massive terrain of Yellowstone lies the main heart and hub of the resistance element known as Eclipse. It is the last line of hope to retake the planet and humanities solar system from the aliens. Currently it is only just equipped enough to support a small number of elite trained resistance fighters. As time goes on it can grow into a power house capable of supporting a larger force or potentially fall to decimation.

The Eight Forests is a rather nice location for hamlets to call home, though its winter weather is rather harsh. Plenty of wild game and fish are there to offset the lack of crops. It holds a small amount of GENESIS occupation, the theory is that they run some sort of tests in the mountainous lands.

Malmstrom ruins is aptly named after the major USAF base in the region. It served for a little while as a key position for heavies and bombers to deploy during the Invasion war. This really only lasted for the first year after its orbital guns were sapped by alien ground forces the base and the surrounding towns were bombarded with with orbital fire. Despite that it still holds some pristine ruins hidden around the area that could be a goldmine for mechanics if discovered.

The second of three megacities in the western US, Neo Denver serves primarily as the gateway to this region. It is the smallest of the three cities, though does not lack in power by any means. Most of the GENESIS forces that are investigating the Glasslands generally come from Neo Denver as well.

One of three Megacities in the western US, Neo LA spans across the coastline of old California from LA's original location to San Francisco. Interestingly, or horrifyingly due to heavy battle in the Morro Bay area the aliens unleashed a devastating attack that cut the land into a deep canyon all the way to Kettleman City causing the Pacific to flood the central lowlands of California.

The last of three megacities in western US, it is the capital of the western US and Canadian areas. It spans from Seattle all the way to Vancouver to control a large swathe of land. The biggest landmark in Neo Seattle are the Towers of Heaven, two mega skyscrapers that dwarf the Seattle Space Needle with ease. The purpose of these towers is largely unknown to humans as the higher floors protected by star ships are locked down to only GENESIS and aliens.

Known mainly as No Man's Land, this location is a zone that has been heavily terraformed by the aliens. This naturally makes it more hostile to human life and difficult to do much of anything in, however it only gets worse from there. Devourer hives are all over the zone here, a horrid bioweapon utilized by the aliens in their terror attacks even GENESIS has difficulties controlling them. Despite the odds being incredibly stacked against people, people will brave this region and some even carve out a home here.

Old Victoria primarily comprises of the ruins of Victoria found across the Straight of Juan de Fuca. While the old city of Victoria wasn't the largest nor the most important city it drew the ire of the aliens due to an old weapons testing facility co-opted by the Americans and Canadians. The weapons built here were among some of the best in the western hemisphere and were decent threat against them, because of this it became a target to orbital bombardment. Now a days the mountainous wetlands are largely wild and untamed, though rumors are some of those weapons facilities might still be hidden in its depths untouched.

Portlandia is the colloquial name for the tomb city of Portland. This was one of the first cities that fell to the terror attacks of the alien invaders. It was so bad that the humans had to unleash some of its nuclear armament on the city to destroy the bioweapons that were unleashed on the city. Despite this the location still is quite dangerous all things considered even with the bioweapons largely removed, at least that is the word on the street.

The Redwoods are a large swathe of land that has the old massive Sequoia National Park and southern reaches of old Oregon. Its nestled in between quite a few dangerous regions all with varying reasons as to why. Despite this, the wild and untamed nature of this area allows for the existence of havens and even a possibility of some sort normal albeit dangerous life.

Unlike its bigger sibling, Las Vegas, Reno managed to remain largely unscathed by the invasion. It wasn't until after that it was run down a little bit, originally a candidate for a Megacity, the seedier elements continued to be more problematic than GENESIS cared to deal with. Due to this it is now a slum city designated endearingly as the Reno Subsector. It primarily serves as a good early warning buffer for the LA Megacity from any dangers that are coming from the east. Luckily, or unluckily gambling culture is quite alive and well here.

Salt Lake City has been confined to being a subsector GENESIS slum. The primary reason behind this is that they prefer to use this city as a means of keeping any of their 'uglier' manufacturing out of view of the average Megacity citizen. Of course this is only for projects that humans are even allowed to see. The area around SLC is rather rough and tumble, making this slum something of an oasis of sorts.

Spokane is a major GENESIS Subsector that houses quite a large amount of people. Most of these are people that either found themselves outcasted from Megacities or never really fit in to begin with. In a way Spokane is a small megacity, at least compared to the other sub sectors in the nearby areas.

Located in the old missile fields of the western US lies the Glasslands. It was one of the largest threats to the invaders when they first came to Earth due to the sheer quantity of nuclear armaments. The aliens would answer in kind with their own super weapons bombarding the land from orbit. The weapons they used would rend the lands to great effect often leaving behind glass like formations. Even stranger was when the Glasslands turned out to be heavily saturated in Paraphysical energies, causing eerie blue-purple glowing in the massive crystal like glass shards. Due to this it holds great interest to many different factions and due to this it remains one of the most dangerous regions.
